summary: Under ST3_PROFILE_DIR, the full reads a daemon makes after it starts are labeled: the replication inventory, sealing recovery, operation audit, doctor report and roster warm-up. Mailbox streams count why each full read happens

replay.detail: No claim, projection or cache changes; nothing is replayed or rebuilt.

schema.detail: No table, index, view, trigger or storage version changes.

rules.detail: Every read and write runs as before; only profile labels, spans and counted notes are added. Without ST3_PROFILE_DIR each costs one atomic load.

compatibility.detail: Mixed-version safe: no wire, client or stored-format change. New profile labels appear in minutes.jsonl, slow.jsonl and totals.json, and four new bounded writer-origin values in OTel writer telemetry.

recovery.detail: Rolling back removes the labels and notes; nothing else changes.
